controls.label: Parameters
controls.superspreadersInfo: Adds 2–4 clusters, each centred on one superspreader connected to at least 6 people. A few people causing many infections is typical of real outbreaks, where most cases infect no one and a few infect many (Lloyd-Smith et al., Nature 2005 [{source}]). Outbreaks take off faster, and R₀ rises because contacts are less even.

infoDescription.covid: COVID-19 deaths rise steeply with age. Before vaccines, an estimated 0.005% of infections were fatal at age 1 (COVID-19 Forecasting Team, Lancet 2022 [{forecasting}]), and 0.01% at 25, 0.4% at 55 and 4.6% at 75 (Levin et al., European Journal of Epidemiology 2020 [{levin}]). Omicron values are scaled down 79% (Liu et al., IJID 2022 [{liu}]). Everyone in the network is set to one age: spread is unchanged, only who dies.
infoDescription.flu: Influenza deaths per symptomatic illness by age, US 2023–24 season (CDC preliminary estimates [{cdc}]): ≈ 0.009% at 0–4, 0.017% at 18–49, 0.063% at 50–64 and 0.73% at 65+. Everyone in the network is set to one age group: spread is unchanged, only who dies.

mpox.title: Epidemiology of Mpox: Integrating Transmission Inference, Biological Mechanisms, and Vaccine Effectiveness
mpox.organization: UC Berkeley | CDC California Center for Outbreak Response
mpox.description: Developing a multi-scale epidemiologic framework to address gaps in mpox surveillance, transmission mechanisms, and vaccine protection. Using phylodynamic simulation, Bayesian hierarchical modeling, and a matched case-control design across 12 U.S. jurisdictions.

rsv.title: Real-World Comparative Effectiveness of RSV Immunization
rsv.organization: UC Berkeley | CDC California Center for Outbreak Response
rsv.description: Led a comparative effectiveness study using Kaiser Permanente Southern California electronic health records (47,650 infants) to evaluate maternal RSV vaccination and infant nirsevimab against antibiotic dispensing. Applied Andersen–Gill Cox regression accounting for recurrent events and time-varying exposures and confounders, plus g-computation to estimate relative and absolute effects, and generated IPTW-adjusted Kaplan–Meier curves to compare time to first antibiotic dispensing across immunization groups. Identified 18–19% lower antibiotic dispensing rates.

suicide-intent.title: Trends in Suicide Intent Disclosure Among U.S. Decedents, 2003–2023
suicide-intent.description: Cleaning and analyzing National Violent Death Reporting System (NVDRS) data to characterize longitudinal trends and risk factors in suicide deaths with versus without warning signs. Using R and Joinpoint Trend Analysis Software. Manuscript in preparation.

nlp-sdoh.title: NLP & LLMs for Social Determinants of Health — Systematic Review
nlp-sdoh.description: Contributed to a systematic review of natural language processing and large language model applications addressing social determinants of health. Responsible for title/abstract screening, full-text review, and data extraction. Published in JMIR, 2026.

phage-therapy.title: In Vitro Phage Therapy: Treating S. epidermidis Biofilm with Phage K
phage-therapy.description: Designed statistical analysis plan; analyzed and visualized experimental data with Python for a study on bacteriophage K treatment of Staphylococcus epidermidis biofilm-coated surgical screws.

test-negative-design.title: Test-Negative Designs for Estimating Scalar Correlates of Protection
test-negative-design.description: Built individual-based simulation models to assess conditions under which test-negative designs can recover the protective effect of scalar immune measures. Performed extensive sensitivity analyses and led manuscript development. Published in American Journal of Epidemiology, 2026.

tb-genomics.title: Genomics of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and TB-HIV Coinfection Burden
tb-genomics.description: Analyzed ambiguous nucleotide calls in M. tuberculosis genome sequencing with R. Assessed WHO and UNAIDS methods for estimating TB-HIV mortality and prevalence, including data source validation and assumption analysis.

behavioral-dynamics.title: Behavioral Dynamics of Epidemic Trajectories & Vaccination
behavioral-dynamics.description: Developed agent-based models in NetLogo to study how behavioral responses and vaccination strategies shape epidemic trajectories. Analyzed and visualized model outputs in Python. Published in JASSS, 2025.

buprenorphine.title: Buprenorphine Treatment & Opioid Overdose Modeling
buprenorphine.description: Modeled long-term effects of buprenorphine treatment seeking, duration, and capacity on overdose fatalities. Analyzed longitudinal trends in buprenorphine receipt and waivered providers in the U.S. Two papers published in Journal of Addiction Medicine and Addiction.

suicide-prevention-review.title: Systematic Review: Suicide Prevention in College Students & COVID-19
suicide-prevention-review.description: Conducted systematic review and meta-analysis of suicide prevention interventions among college students before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. Applied ROBINS-I and RoB2 risk-of-bias tools.
